description: What data/benchmarks.json displays. Each engine shows exactly one measurement set: sessions of the listed configurations, on the backends listed for each (so other runs of a configuration, such as the CPU reference run of an accelerator configuration, never displace a board row), recorded with exactly this engine and binding version, measured on or after measuredFrom; or, for an engine not yet re-measured, its rows from before version recording, all measured in one month. carryover keeps rows without versions displayed until the campaign of the declared set re-measures or retires them. retiredKeys are row keys removed from the board; each reason stays here and in data/sessions/index.json, never on the page. Applied by scripts/aggregate.mjs; see docs/RUN-CONDITIONS.md, Measurement sets.

carryover.reason: July 2026 llama.cpp rows (no recorded version) stay displayed until the llama.rn 0.13.0-rc.7 campaign re-measures or retires each of them; the campaign publication empties this list.

retiredKeys.reason: replaced by Q4_K_M; Q4_0 CPU reference misses a correctness probe
